terms.gloss: cloth or towel; the bath towel

terms.comment: Traupman’s word; classically a frieze coat.

phrases.latin: Ē soliō ēgressum pater linteō siccāvit
phrases.english: When he got out of the bath, Dad dried him with a towel

towels.html: The bath towel is linteum (Jack’s ruling, 29 October 2026), not Traupman’s gausapina, classically a frieze coat.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
